solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing; clues and answers read from cryptics.georgeho.org (ODbL)'s copy of the post

clue.text: Old nuisance about to come in to squeeze king

indicators.note: the turned pieces are told to come in, so they go inside the word for squeeze

parts.note: to squeeze or crush into a space is to jam

indicators.note: about here signals turning the old-plus-nuisance pair back to front

parts.note: a bore is a tiresome nuisance

explanation.surface: A tiresome old character barges in to put pressure on a monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old nuisance' reads like a description of the king, but it is two separate pieces, and 'about' turns both back to front before they go in.
explanation.definitionFit: Jeroboam was the first ruler of the northern kingdom of Israel in the Old Testament.

clue.text: Cocker spaniel's head sinking after quarrel with little girl

indicators.note: in a down clue, sinking sends the letter to the bottom, after the other pieces

parts.note: a jar is a dated word for a quarrel or row
Vi is a short form of the girl's name Violet

indicators.note: the head of a word is its opening letter

explanation.surface: A cocker spaniel droops its head after a squabble with a small girl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cocker' looks like part of 'Cocker spaniel' but stands alone as the definition: Jarvis Cocker, singer with the British band Pulp.
explanation.definitionFit: Jarvis is the first name of the musician Jarvis Cocker, so the surname clues his forename.

clue.text: Film as recreation?

definitions.meaning: a new version of an old movie
read as re-creation, making something over again

explanation.surface: Is watching a movie a form of leisure?
explanation.definitionFit: A new version of an older picture is a re-creation of it, made a second time.

clue.text: Group of hunters having a change of heart

indicators.note: the middle letter of the hunters' word is swapped for another, a literal change at its heart

parts.note: beagles are hounds used for hunting hares

explanation.surface: A band of hunters decide to change their minds.
explanation.walkthrough: The central G of BEAGLES becomes T.
explanation.definitionFit: The Beatles were the famous Liverpool pop band, a musical group.

clue.text: A fellow gets round stretch of open country offering reason for lack of greenery?

parts.note: a gent is a man or fellow
O is round in shape
a range is a large area of open grazing land

explanation.surface: A man goes round open land explaining why nothing green grows there.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gets round' reads as one piece of travel, but 'round' alone gives O.
explanation.definitionFit: This defoliant was sprayed by the US military in Vietnam to strip forest leaves.

clue.text: Say nothing in a prison cell?

explanation.surface: A prisoner told to keep quiet in his cell.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both fall silent and imprisoned, confined indoors.

clue.text: Turn away from explosive fuss getting very loud

parts.note: HE stands for high explosive
ado is fuss or bother
ff, fortissimo, is the musical mark for very loud

explanation.surface: Someone turns aside from a noisy, explosive row.
explanation.definitionFit: To head off is to intercept and divert, sending someone in another direction.

clue.text: Insects with unusual emitters

indicators.note: unusual tells us the letters of emitters are put in an unusual order

explanation.surface: Bugs that give off something odd.
explanation.definitionFit: Termites are social wood-eating insects, sometimes called white ants.

clue.text: Project for truth, originally violent?

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of

indicators.note: originally points to the opening letter of truth

parts.note: rude can mean rough or violent, as in a rude awakening

explanation.surface: A campaign for truth that started out violent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Project' looks like a noun but is the verb, to stick out.
explanation.definitionFit: To project is to jut out from a surface, the same as sticking out.

clue.text: One is looking for something silver encased in glass

indicators.note: encased in tells us the metal sits inside the drinking vessel

parts.note: a rummer is a large drinking glass
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: Someone is searching for a piece of silver set in glass.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who rummages searches through things to find an item.

clue.text: Bob perhaps appearing in party after show

indicators.note: after places the party after the show in the answer

parts.note: Hair is the famous rock musical
a do is a party or celebration

explanation.surface: Bob turns up at a party after the show.
explanation.walkthrough: Bob looks like a man's name; it is a short haircut.
explanation.definitionFit: A bob is a style of haircut, an example of a styled coiffure.

clue.text: Component of psychological test could get you to blink frantically

indicators.note: frantically signals the letters of to blink are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A test that makes the subject blink madly.
explanation.definitionFit: The Rorschach test asks people to interpret symmetrical splodges of ink.

clue.text: Fade away in desolate place that's less cheerful

indicators.note: in places the fading word inside the bleak place

parts.note: a moor is open bleak upland
to die away is to fade

explanation.surface: Wasting away on a bleak spot makes one gloomier.
explanation.definitionFit: Moodier means more sullen or gloomy, so less happy.

clue.text: Sound fellows with excellent quality Society brought in

parts.note: men are fellows

indicators.note: brought in puts the society letter inside the next pair of pieces

parts.note: A1 means first-rate, written AI
a trait is a characteristic quality

explanation.surface: Decent men with fine qualities are admitted to a Society.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' looks like an adjective, healthy; it is a noun, a channel of water. The Menai Strait separates Anglesey from mainland Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: A sound is a narrow sea channel, and this one divides Anglesey from Wales.

clue.text: Dusty part of the farm next to where water gushes up

indicators.note: next to sets the farm part beside the water source

parts.note: a spring is where water rises from the ground
a field is part of a farm

explanation.surface: A dry, dusty field beside a well.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dusty' reads as dry; it is the singer Dusty Springfield.
explanation.definitionFit: Dusty Springfield was a hugely popular British pop singer of the 1960s.

clue.text: Female given religious instruction stars in Christian organisations

parts.note: RI is a school abbreviation for religious instruction
Aries is a constellation, a group of stars

explanation.surface: A woman taught religion stars within church groups.
explanation.definitionFit: Friaries are communities of friars, religious orders within the Church.

clue.text: Mineral left with diamonds in iron box

indicators.note: in sets the two letters inside, between the metal symbol and the boxing word

parts.note: Fe is the chemical symbol for iron
to spar is to box
D is the card abbreviation for diamonds

explanation.surface: A mineral, with some stones, kept in an iron chest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'box' looks like a container but is the verb, to fight.
explanation.definitionFit: Feldspar is a common rock-forming silicate, a mineral group.

clue.text: Bird animal knocked over flags

indicators.note: knocked over in an across clue means the creature's letters are turned back

parts.note: a deer is an animal
bunting is a string of small flags

explanation.surface: A creature knocks down the decorative flags.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a small brown European songbird of reedbeds and marshes.

clue.text: Boy is performing 'The Lord bless you and keep you' maybe

definitions.text: 'The Lord bless you and keep you' maybe

parts.note: Ben is a boy's name
on means performing, on stage

explanation.surface: A choirboy sings a well-known blessing.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition quotes a famous priestly blessing from Numbers.
explanation.definitionFit: A benison is a blessing, and the quoted words are an example of one.

clue.text: Saint Arnold?

definitions.meaning: a saint is a virtuous, holy person
Lord Arnold ... was a prominent British lawyer and political adviser

explanation.walkthrough: Arnold Goodman was a famous British solicitor and fixer of the 1960s and 70s.
explanation.definitionFit: A saint is a virtuous person, and Arnold Goodman was the noted lawyer of that surname.

clue.text: Gap gives husband a suit that's fancy

indicators.note: fancy describes something elaborate or made up, so the letters of a suit are freely rearranged

explanation.surface: A rift opens when a man gets an extravagant outfit.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue as given stops after 'husband'; the blog's hint shows the missing words, 'a suit' and 'that's fancy', which shuffle to IATUS.
explanation.definitionFit: A hiatus is a break or pause, a gap in a sequence.

clue.text: Rocky bits from an enduring band

definitions.meaning: the Rolling ..., a long-lasting rock group

explanation.surface: Pieces of rock chipped off a long-running band.
explanation.definitionFit: Stones are pieces of rock, and the Stones are the Rolling Stones, still touring.

clue.text: Like something that's hard to eat?

definitions.text: Like something that's hard to eat?

parts.words: Like something that's hard to eat?
parts.note: describes pasta cooked so it still offers some firmness to the bite, not food that is difficult to eat

explanation.walkthrough: 'hard to eat' suggests something unpleasant; it means firm when bitten, from the Italian for 'to the tooth'.
explanation.definitionFit: Pasta cooked to this point is firm when bitten, slightly resistant to the teeth.

clue.text: Follower of Catholic theologian even if, in short, a dimmer of judgement

parts.note: tho is a shortened spelling of though, meaning even if
a mist clouds the judgement, as in red mist

explanation.surface: A disciple of a theologian, though briefly clouded in his thinking.
explanation.definitionFit: A Thomist follows the teaching of Saint Thomas Aquinas, the medieval Catholic theologian.

clue.text: Wicked? Yours truly is? Pooh-pooh!

parts.note: yours truly is the speaker, so it means I am, I'M
pish is an exclamation of contempt, dismissing something

explanation.surface: Accused of wickedness, the writer scoffs at the idea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wicked' here is in its mild sense of mischievous.
explanation.definitionFit: Impish means mischievous, playfully naughty like a little devil.

clue.text: Extract of dried blood in ham tea is disgusting

indicators.note: disgusting here signals the letters of in ham tea are spoiled and rearranged

explanation.surface: A grim discovery: dried blood in the ham tea.
explanation.definitionFit: Haematin is a pigment obtained from haemoglobin in blood.

clue.text: Fuss about trade being reduced by 60% in firm

indicators.note: about places the fuss word around the shortened trade word

parts.note: song as in song and dance, a fuss

indicators.note: being reduced by, with the figure that follows, says most of the trade word is cut away, leaving its opening two letters

explanation.surface: A row over trade falling by sixty per cent within a company.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being reduced by 60%' means three of five letters go, keeping the first two. 'Fuss' gives a word from 'song and dance'. 'firm' looks like a business; it is the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Strong and firm both describe something solid, sturdy and resolute.

clue.text: Gun that's very big is possible cause of blockage in passageway

definitions.text: possible cause of blockage in passageway

parts.note: the Sten is a British submachine gun
OS is the clothing abbreviation for outsize

explanation.surface: A massive gun might jam a corridor.
explanation.definitionFit: Stenosis is the abnormal narrowing of a bodily duct or vessel.
